body:
Fixed in 4a4120e: on the Calculate rate tab a date without a market rate now recomputes the rate from the typed amounts instead of blanking it, and a failed lookup does the same. A system test covers it (`a calculated rate survives a date without a market rate`).

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

Fixed in 4a4120e: when the first lookup fails or returns an unreadable response, a form redrawn with a rate keeps it and shows the field for manual entry. Missing or equal currencies still clear it. A failure of a stale request is now ignored as well.

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

Fixed in 4a4120e: unrounded amounts still round to 15 significant digits, but only when that just drops float drift (a few units in the last place). Otherwise the 16th and 17th digits are kept, so `12345678901234.25` stays as typed, while `0.1+0.2` is still `0.3` and tiny BTC rates keep their digits. Unit tests cover both cases.

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

Fixed in 4a4120e: the message now says the exchange rate must be positive and fees cannot be negative, in English and all 14 other locales.
